source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops a forward SCM conditioning operation; intervention commutation is restricted away from selection ancestors and is not an inverse same-selected-law countermodel construction.
The paper gives positive same-observable-law separators for conditional generalized identification and emphasizes why positivity matters for completeness.

The paper supplies a general identification algorithm for data fusion under systematic selection with arbitrary unobserved confounding and selection processes; it is relevant to the two-sample application audit but does not subsume one-selected-law latent S-ID completeness.
